newsitem.title: USA: 'Casting wide net' for new US forest chief - USDA.
newsitem.headline: 'Casting wide net' for new US forest chief - USDA.

text.p: The Clinton administration is "casting a wide net" in seeking a new U.S. Forest Service chief, Agriculture Undersecretary Jim Lyons said Tuesday.
Speaking at a think tank, Lyons said the ideal candidate would be familiar with Congress and the legislative process as well as schooled in forestry issues and at ease with Forest Service procedures.
"We are casting a wide net," Lyons said, adding there was no deadline to pick a successor to the retiring Jack Ward Thomas.
Controversy over timber policy and restructing the agency "requires the agency to have strong leadership," Lyons said.
